repository_evidence: Onyxia starts the encounter and Nefarian prepares landing after a local 24s event; Nefarian cannot be killed before phase 3
Children of Deathwing triggers at sibling distance <=50yd
Electrocute is scheduled when Nefarian crosses 90,80,...10% health; local delay is 5s and local Onyxia charge increment is 17 stacks
three prototypes spawn on fixed platforms; local Blast Nova first cast is 3.5s and repeats 13s
normal phase 3 waits for all three prototype deaths; heroic schedules phase 3 after the first prototype death
Dominion builds four portal stalkers per controlled player and selects the farthest portal; local target cap is 5 in 10-player and 2 in 25-player
Explosive Cinders is scheduled heroic in phase 2 and detonates on aura expiry
reset/evade removes heroic auras, despawns actors, sets FAIL and schedules a 30s respawn
